binaries.name: yara
binaries.why: Match a recovered sample against rules the case supplies, recording the engine version, the ruleset's source, revision and hash, and each match's location. No rules ship with this pack and none is fetched during an examination; a match is a classification lead, not proof of execution or attribution. On Linux the image installs it from the Debian snapshot dated in images/debian-snapshot, so the version is the one Debian 12 (bookworm) held on that date (4.2.3-4 at the time of writing) and the image's inventory records it; the apt line is not edited, the snapshot pins it. Homebrew on macOS is not pinned.
